title: 第15章 谁说我没钱第16章 出神入化的暗劲
lines: 第二天，唐明来到学校，班上同学看到他安然无恙，都很惊讶。
同桌王冲惊愕道：“唐哥，你昨天没事吧？”
“你看我像是有事的样子吗？”
唐明笑着反问。
王冲还是有些担忧：“唐哥，如果昨天许杰没报仇的话，今天肯定会来，要不你请个假吧。”
他并不知道，许杰和樊晨两人已经被唐明彻底废了。
两人现在还躺在医院没从昏迷中清醒，消息没传到学校，大家都以为昨天是许杰有事放过了唐明。
“不用，他们还没那个资格。”
唐明淡笑一声，无视周围人怪异的眼神，自顾自的坐下来开始看书。
见他心态良好，王冲倒是忧心忡忡，生怕许杰和樊晨冲进教室教训唐明。
可担心了一整天，都没见有人过来。
很快，就到了下午放学。
唐明扭头道：“对了王冲，你身上有钱吗？借我点，明天还你。”
“有的有的，今天特意找我老爸拿了点。”
王冲赶紧从怀里拿出一千元，咧嘴一笑：“唐哥，你也别心疼这一千块，就当买个平安，平平静静度过高三这段时间，比什么多好。”
“许杰他们也就贪财，把钱给了就没什么事了。”
他还以为唐明借钱，是为了交保护费。
“谢了。”
唐明也过多不解释，拿了钱就走出教室。
唐明并没有回柳姨家，而是打了个出租，来到南城区的文庙古街。
文庙古街，又被称为古玩市场。
街道上热闹非凡，不少商贩都摆着地摊吆喝。
“来来来，大家来看看，这是我老李家流传百年的传家宝，大清朝皇家特供瓷器，有价无市。”
“走过路过不要错过，洛河出土的文物，买到即赚到。”
“绝世璞玉，价格公道，都来看看啊。”
“小哥，我这有佛门高僧开光的菩提子，可镇魔驱邪，也能颐养气神，童叟无欺……”
各种吆喝声不绝于耳。
唐明对这些摊位瞥了眼后，便不再感兴趣。
全是假货。
好比那个佛门高僧开光的菩提子，只是一颗后期加工的核桃子，别说镇魔驱邪，买回去不发芽就很不错了。
很快。
唐明走进一家名为‘聚宝阁’的店铺，店铺很大，瓷器、金银器、古玉堂、赌石档、古书名画应有尽有。
里面的顾客非富即贵，能够玩得起这行业的人，家产最少百万级别，像唐明这种高中生，仅此一个。
左看看又看看。
唐明都没有看到满意的东西，正准备上二楼的时候，却被人拦了下来。
“小子，观察你有段时间了，一直闲逛不买东西，还不断摇头，莫非是看不起我们‘聚宝阁’的东西？”
一名大肚便便的中年男子，堵住唐明上楼梯的路。
此人衣服上挂着铭牌，写着“大堂经理，廖文博”等字样。
“没看到满意的。”
唐明淡淡开口。
廖文博嗤笑一声：“笑话，聚宝阁是中海乃至华南最大的古玩店铺，怎么会没有满意的？”
“我看不是不满意，而是买不起吧。”
content_en:
The next day, Tang Ming came to school. His classmates were surprised to see that he was safe and sound.
Wang Chong, who was at the same table, said in shock: "Brother Tang, were you okay yesterday?"
"Do you think I'm in trouble?"
Tang Ming asked with a smile.
Wang Chong was still a little worried: "Brother Tang, if Xu Jie didn't take revenge yesterday, he would definitely come today. Why don't you ask for leave?"
He didn't know that Xu Jie and Fan Chen had been completely destroyed by Tang Ming.
The two of them are still lying in the hospital and haven't woken up from the coma. The news has not reached the school. Everyone thinks that Xu Jie let Tang Ming go yesterday because of something.
"No, they are not qualified yet."
Tang Ming smiled lightly, ignored the weird looks from the people around him, sat down and started reading.
Seeing that he had a good attitude, Wang Chong was worried, fearing that Xu Jie and Fan Chen would burst into the classroom and teach Tang Ming a lesson.
But after worrying all day, no one came.
Soon, it was time to finish school in the afternoon.
Tang Ming turned around and said, "By the way, Wang Chong, do you have any money? Lend me some and I'll return it to you tomorrow."
"There are some. I went to my dad to get some today."
Wang Chong quickly took out a thousand yuan from his arms and grinned: "Brother Tang, don't feel bad about this thousand yuan. Just think of it as buying peace and quiet and spend your senior year in high school. It's better than anything else."
"Xu Jie and the others are just greedy for money. If you give them the money, nothing will happen."
He thought Tang Ming borrowed money to pay protection fees.
"Thanks."
Tang Ming also didn't explain too much and walked out of the classroom after taking the money.
…
Tang Ming did not go back to Aunt Liu's house, but took a taxi and came to the Confucian Temple Ancient Street in Nancheng District.
Confucian Temple Ancient Street is also known as the antique market.
The streets were very lively, with many vendors setting up stalls and shouting.
"Come on, come on, let's take a look. This is a heirloom that has been handed down for hundreds of years from my old Li family. It is a porcelain specially provided to the royal family of the Qing Dynasty. It has a price but no market."
"Don't miss it when you pass by. You can earn money by buying the cultural relics unearthed in Luohe."
"Peerless jade, the price is reasonable, come and take a look."
"Brother, I have a Bodhi seed consecrated by a Buddhist monk. It can suppress demons and exorcise evil spirits, and it can also nourish the spirit and spirit. Children and old men are not deceived..."
All kinds of shouts were heard.
After Tang Ming glanced at these stalls, he was no longer interested.
All fake.
Just like the Bodhi seed consecrated by a Buddhist monk, it is just a post-processed walnut. Not to mention suppressing evil spirits and driving away evil spirits, it is very good to buy it without sprouting.
soon.
Tang Ming walked into a shop called 'Jubao Pavilion'. The shop was very large and had everything from porcelain, gold and silverware, ancient jade halls, stone gambling stalls, ancient books and famous paintings.
The customers inside are either rich or noble. Those who can afford this industry have a family fortune of at least one million. High school students like Tang Ming are the only ones.
Look left and look again.
Tang Ming didn't even see anything he was satisfied with. When he was about to go up to the second floor, he was stopped by someone.
"Boy, I've been watching you for a while. You've been wandering around without buying anything, and you keep shaking your head. Could it be that you look down on the things in our 'Treasure Pavilion'?"
A middle-aged man with a big belly blocked Tang Ming's way up the stairs.
There was a nameplate hanging on this person's clothes, which read "Lobby Manager, Liao Wenbo" and other words.
"I didn't see anything satisfactory."
Tang Ming spoke calmly.
Liao Wenbo sneered: "It's a joke. Jubao Pavilion is the largest antique store in Zhonghai and even South China. How can there be no satisfaction?"
"I think it's not that I'm not satisfied, but that I can't afford it."
